title: Enterprise Ask Consolidation and Scope Heuristics (Sales/CS Intake)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable, low-friction process for aggregating enterprise (Sales/CS) non-bug feature requests, deduplicating similar asks, and producing a first-pass scope + prioritization that PMs can action. Background: Sales and CS currently escalate bespoke asks directly to PMs and engineers. That causes duplicate work, inconsistent scoping, and late discovery of compliance/infra constraints. Goal: Reduce intake-to-decision time, standardize data collected, and produce a triage artifact that includes consolidation, recommended priority, and rough engineering estimates. Scope: Only non-bug enterprise feature asks (product/UX/infra features requested by customers or prospects). Exclude clearly scoped integration contracts or professional services engagements (those are tagged separately). This ticket produces: intake template, deduplication heuristics, a prioritization rubric, a scoping checklist, a one-page triage worksheet, and automation wiring guidance for Sales/CS tooling.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Intake template accepted by Sales and CS leads; 2) Triage rubric defined with scoring thresholds for P0/P1/P2 and documented; 3) Deduplication heuristic implemented as a first-pass script or Zapier flow and validated on last 90 days of asks; 4) A weekly triage artifact (consolidated list + recommended scopes) delivered to PM/ENG each Monday for 4 consecutive weeks; 5) Hand-off steps and required fields are recorded and linked in Confluence.
suggested_form_template: Fields: customer_name; customer_segment; contact_owner; brief_problem_statement (50-200 chars); desired_outcome; priority_for_customer (1-5); estimated_revenue_impact (USD range); expected_traffic/volume; data_sensitivity (none|low|medium|high); compliance_required (yes/no + detail); required_sla (p99 latency/availability); suggested_deadline; must_have_integrations; attachments (specs/threads); existing_product_workarounds; is_duplicate_of (internal key if known)
scoping_matrix_table: Columns: FeatureArea | BusinessImpact | IntegrationComplexity | DataSensitivity | InfraRequired (GPUs, storage, realtime) | ApproxEngT-Shirt (S/M/L/XL) | RiskNotes. Heuristic: any row with DataSensitivity=high OR InfraRequired contains GPUs => escalate to Private/Dedicated review; IntegrationComplexity=M on two or more systems => add 2 weeks integration buffer.
prioritization_rubric: Scoring (0-5 per axis) weighted: RevenuePotential 28%, StrategicAlignment 24%, CustomerHealth/RetentionRisk 20%, Compliance/Risk 12%, EngineeringEffort (inverse score) 16%. Sum >= 4.0 => P0/P1 depending on deadline; 3.0-3.99 => P1; 2.0-2.99 => P2; <2.0 => Backlog. Tie-breaker: multi-customer interest wins over single-customer unless revenue or retention risk is critical.
initial_decisions: 1) Canonical intake will be a Salesforce case form + short Google form fallback for CS, not email; 2) Deduplication will run weekly using keyword + semantic similarity on problem_statement + customer feature area tags; 3) PMs will receive a consolidated triage worksheet every Monday; 4) All asks that touch data residency, encryption, or regulatory boundaries must include 'data_sensitivity' and 'compliance_required' fields and will be auto-flagged for Security review.
open_questions: What threshold of revenue counts as 'strategic' for immediate escalation? (sales to propose bands)
Which Salesforce field is canonical for 'is_duplicate_of' to support dedupe? (sales/ops input)
Do we auto-assign engineering SMEs for infra-heavy asks or require PM to request?
Should Professional Services opportunities stay in the same queue or be routed to PS ops?
